channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ukraine pushes Russia back in Donetsk as military, civilian casualties soar
item.description: Russia is fighting for settlements it once firmly held in Donetsk, and has retreated from many others.

item.title: Ukraine takes aim at Russia’s AI data infrastructure
item.description: Drone attacks target Russian digital giant Yandex, as well as continuing strikes on missile plants and oil refineries.

item.title: Saudi Arabia reopens Riyadh airport after Houthi attack kills three
item.description: Saudi Arabia has seen several attacks by the Houthis in recent days, with airports appearing to be the primary target.

item.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
item.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

item.title: ​​USS Lincoln finally docks in San Diego after 10-month mission
item.description: The US aircraft carrier was set to return in May but the war with Iran has kept it at sea on one of the longest deployments ever.

item.title: Watch: Why was the sign at the British consulate in East Jerusalem removed?
item.description: The consulate, first established in 1838, was set to be closed by the Israeli government in retaliation for UK sanctions.
